correctness.rationale: For every phase, the merged enumeration tends to the distinguished point. Onto maps from source interval k+1 to target component k are continuous at every isolated component and at the distinguished accumulation point. Interval rank strictly decreases along nonterminal forward orbits, while chosen backward preimages have unbounded rank and converge to phase points; one epsilon-jump then proves chain transitivity. The source full-text Theorem A gives the claimed realization.
